notes: Scope: every visual slot rendered by / (app/page.tsx), /provider (components/ProviderLandingPage.tsx) and /contact (components/ContactPage.tsx). No src/ directory exists.
Skipped by rule: navbar/footer brand logos, small UI icons (FAQ plus, copy/check), the 24px check SVG overlaid on the provider hero phone.

Skipped as out of scope: app/opengraph-image.png and app/provider/opengraph-image.png (static share cards), app/not-found.tsx (no image slots), unused legacy components (AboutSection, HowItWorksSection, HeroImageStage, etc.).
status 'inactive' = the section is currently commented out in app/page.tsx; not generated unless you say so.
reuses = slot uses another entry's file instead of generating a duplicate.
aspectRatio = the frame the asset is shown in; generated art should be composed for it with transparent padding.

assets.section: Home hero: 'Based on our calculations, you need QwikHelp.'
assets.visualSpec: Authentic Nigerian male artisan in his late 20s, clean navy work polo with tool belt, warm confident smile, holding up a smartphone toward the viewer as if showing a confirmed booking; three-quarter body, slight angle, friendly approachable posture, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home problem: 'Finding good help shouldn't feel like a gamble.'
assets.visualSpec: Authentic Nigerian woman homeowner in her 30s, modern smart-casual Ankara-print top, looking at her phone with a thoughtful, slightly unsure expression (hand near chin), waist-up, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home services card: 'Cooks — Daily meals, meal prep or a party.'
assets.visualSpec: Authentic Nigerian female cook in a crisp white chef jacket and headwrap, stirring a pot of jollof rice, warm smile, waist-up, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home services card: 'Cleaners — Regular, deep or move-out cleans.'
assets.visualSpec: Authentic Nigerian female cleaner in a fitted blue work tunic and gloves, holding a mop and a bucket of supplies, cheerful expression, three-quarter body, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home services card: 'Plumbers — Leaks, blocked drains, new fittings.'
assets.visualSpec: Authentic Nigerian male plumber in navy overalls over a fitted tee, holding a red pipe wrench and a length of PVC pipe, confident smile, waist-up, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home services card: 'Electricians — Wiring, sockets and inverters.'
assets.visualSpec: Authentic Nigerian male electrician in a hi-vis vest and yellow hard hat, coil of cable over one shoulder, holding a voltage tester, friendly expression, waist-up, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home services card: 'AC & appliances — Servicing, gas top-ups and repairs.'
assets.visualSpec: Authentic Nigerian male AC technician in a grey work shirt with a tool pouch, holding refrigerant pressure gauges, focused but warm expression, waist-up, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home services card: 'Carpenters — Furniture, doors and fittings.'
assets.visualSpec: Authentic Nigerian male carpenter in an olive shirt and brown leather apron, holding a claw hammer and a wooden plank, proud smile, waist-up, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home how it works, step 1: 'Find a pro near you — Pick a service and see verified pros in your area.'
assets.visualSpec: Flat phone mockup showing a simplified map in #E8F0FE with a #0057FF location pin; three rounded pro cards fan out beside it, each with a circular avatar of a Nigerian pro (skin #5C3824 / #3D2314 / #8D5524) and a small #00B862 verified pill; dashed #0057FF connectors link pin to cards.

assets.section: Home how it works, step 2: 'Book and pay safely — Choose a time. Your payment waits in escrow.'
assets.visualSpec: Rounded booking card (#FFFFFF on #E8F0FE pad) with a calendar strip and a selected #0057FF time pill; below it a #082567 vault/lock badge with a dashed line flowing from a naira coin into it; small #00B862 'secured' pill.

assets.section: Home how it works, step 3: 'Approve, then they get paid — Release payment in one tap.'
assets.visualSpec: Large rounded #0057FF button with a white check being tapped by a flat hand (skin #8D5524); dashed connector arcs from the button to a wallet card where a #00B862 naira amount pill appears; small star rating row in #082567.

assets.section: Home trust: 'Every pro is verified — ID, face match, skills check and a guarantor.'
assets.visualSpec: Rounded ID card in #FFFFFF with a flat portrait of a Nigerian pro (skin #3D2314, navy shirt #082567), pill-shaped text lines in #E8F0FE, and a large #00B862 shield-check badge overlapping the corner; dashed face-scan brackets in #0057FF around the portrait.

assets.section: Home trust: 'Your money is protected — Payment is released only when you approve.'
assets.visualSpec: Flat #082567 safe/vault with a rounded door and a #0057FF dial; a stack of naira coins rests inside; a padlock pill in #00B862 floats above; dashed path from vault to a 'released' #FFFFFF card.

assets.section: Home trust: 'We've got your back — If a job goes wrong, we fix it or refund you.'
assets.visualSpec: Rounded support chat bubble in #0057FF with a white wrench glyph, a second #FFFFFF bubble with a circular refund-arrow in #00B862; behind them a large #E8F0FE shield shape; dashed connector between bubbles.

assets.section: Home for-pros band: 'Good at what you do? Get paid for it, every time.'
assets.visualSpec: Two authentic Nigerian artisans (a woman tailor and a man mechanic) side by side in contemporary trade attire, relaxed proud smiles, waist-up, isolated cut-out.

assets.section: Home final CTA: 'Be first in line.'
assets.visualSpec: Flat phone mockup with a #0057FF screen and white check, surrounded by geometric confetti (pills, circles, triangles) in #0057FF, #00B862 and #082567; a small #FFFFFF 'You're on the list' pill.

assets.section: Provider hero: 'Good work deserves to be seen.'
assets.currentAsset: /hero-workers.png (already a transparent cut-out of 4 Nigerian pros)
assets.aspectRatio: 16:9, figures cropped flush at bottom edge
assets.visualSpec: Four authentic Nigerian service pros standing side by side, waist-up, cropped flush at the bottom: a woman chef in white jacket, a man electrician in hi-vis vest and hard hat, a man plumber in navy overalls holding up a smartphone with a blank screen facing the viewer, and a man carpenter in a leather apron; warm confident smiles, isolated cut-out.
assets.warning: The blue phone-screen overlay (ProviderLandingPage.tsx:144) and the OG cards are hand-positioned to the current photo. Regenerating means re-measuring the overlay or dropping it. Recommend KEEPING the current photo.

assets.section: Provider why: 'Less chasing work. More doing what you do best.'
assets.visualSpec: Flat neighbourhood of rounded house blocks in #E8F0FE and #FFFFFF; a central #0057FF pro pin with a Nigerian pro avatar (skin #5C3824); dashed #0057FF radius ring and dashed connectors to three houses, each with a small #00B862 'new request' pill.

assets.section: Provider journey step 1: 'Get verified — Submit your NIN or BVN, photo ID and a guarantor.'
assets.visualSpec: Phone in #082567 showing an upload checklist of three pill rows (NIN/BVN, photo ID, guarantor) with #00B862 ticks; a rounded ID card with a Nigerian woman's portrait (skin #8D5524) slides in along a dashed path.

assets.section: Provider journey step 2: 'Go live — We review your details and your profile goes live.'
assets.visualSpec: Rounded profile card with a Nigerian male pro avatar (skin #3D2314), name pills, and a large #00B862 'Live' pill; a #0057FF verified seal badge overlaps the corner; small sparkle shapes in #0057FF.

assets.section: Provider journey step 3: 'Meet nearby clients — Households near you find and book you directly.'
assets.visualSpec: Two flat Nigerian figures (pro, skin #5C3824, in navy work shirt; homeowner, skin #8D5524, in smart-casual top) greeting at a rounded doorway in #E8F0FE; a #0057FF booking notification pill floats above with a dashed connector.

assets.section: Provider journey step 4: 'Do the work, get paid — Payment is released to your wallet when the job is done.'
assets.visualSpec: Rounded wallet card in #0057FF with a white naira symbol; dashed path from a #082567 escrow vault into the wallet; #00B862 '+ payment received' pill; a bank building glyph in #E8F0FE at the end of a second dashed path (withdraw).

assets.section: Provider escrow: 'No more starting a job on a promise.'
assets.visualSpec: Split composition: left, a customer phone sending naira coins along a dashed path into a central #082567 vault with an #00B862 lock pill; right, a pro's phone showing a #00B862 'Payment secured — start job' card. Flat, rounded, no outlines.
